rule_gaps: Kid Interiør's 'Soverom > Puter|Dyner|Putetrekk|Kappelaken|Sengetepper|Madrassbeskytter' bedding tree resolves to Furniture — 14 rows in this shard alone; the vocabulary needs pute/dyne/putevar/putetrekk/kappelaken/sengeteppe/madrassbeskytter → Home (keep 'madrass' itself in Furniture)
'teppe'/'matte'/'Wiltontepper'/'Friezematter' (rugs) resolve to Furniture; rugs are Home
'Innredning > Dekorasjon' and 'Vaser'/'Posters' resolve to Furniture — decor, figurines, bowls, bouquets, posters and wall signs are Home
'hundemadrass'/'hundeseng'/'Hjem > Hund > Hundesenger og madrasser' resolve to Furniture; pet beds are Pets (the shop is also a giveaway: Nettdyret, Zooservice, Dyrekassen, PetXL)
'Turmøbler' (Helinox packable camping furniture) resolves to Furniture; it belongs in Outdoor
facetrules type: 'TV-benk' matches the seating rule via 'benk' and returns Chairs; TV benches are Storage
facetrules type: the 'hage'-prefixed compounds (hagebord, hagestol, barkrakk, familiekøye) derive no type at all
facetrules seats: '2,5-seter' yields seats=5 — the digit after the decimal comma wins
facetrules material: 'kunstrotting' (synthetic rattan) derives Wood, and a cleaning fluid 'for tekstil' derives Fabric from the thing it is used ON
every one of the 300 rows carries icon 'sofa' (the Furniture default), so pillowcases, vases and posters all render a sofa; icon should follow a corrected cat in the same PATCH
Chilli/Trademax rows arrive with the raw Beliani feed string (Swedish text, a literal 'NO_BRAND' token, '||' attribute separators) and brand Unspecified even though the name leads with the brand
notes: Structurally healthy — the furniture proper (sofas, beds, tables, chairs, storage) is classified and faceted well. Nearly all of the damage is at the edges: a Kid Interiør bedding/textile tree and a Rum21 decor tree that should be Home (24 rows), pet beds, camping chairs and pool/gazebo gear that belong in other categories, plus 45 rows of unwired variant families — Boisdale alone ships seven bed-frame sizes and Conform nine identically-named recliners as separate top-level products, which is what a shopper sees as a page of duplicates.
